scope: Step 1 source acquisition only; not a manifest or applicability certification
timestamp_note: Per-file retrieved_at values are actual client UTC completion timestamps. recorded_at is an approximate evidence assembly time.
discovery_method: Navigated official VBPL Tải về tabs; clicked attachment buttons and observed exact Ministry of Justice gateway requests. TT89 government fallback discovered through search, then attachment href read directly from official government record. No attachment URLs guessed.
preservation: Downloaded bytes saved with exclusive creation (xb), no overwrites. Existing source_inventory.json and existing snapshots unchanged. No archive extraction to disk. No packages installed.

verification_methods.ZIP: Python stdlib zipfile central directory listing and testzip CRC streaming check; no extraction. Names checked for absolute paths, parent traversal and colon/drive paths.
verification_methods.RAR: Installed C:/WINDOWS/system32/tar.exe -tf, return code 0; no extraction. Listed names checked for absolute paths, parent traversal and colon/drive paths. Listing alone does not test all compressed payloads or DOC content.
verification_methods.DOCX: ZIP package CRC check, word/document.xml read in memory; header explicitly names Annex I attached to TT89/2026 dated 30 June 2026.
verification_methods.PDF: Installed PyMuPDF parsed 839 pages; page images visually sampled. Text extraction shows only signature metadata, not an accessible body text layer. Cryptographic digital signatures not validated.
